description:
Use this when the user wants clips removed from their Library: "delete this clip", "get rid of the bad ones",
        "clear out that batch". This cannot be undone: the video files are removed and RipClip keeps no copy, so ask the
        user to confirm which clips (names from list_clips) before calling. The video they were cut from stays.
        clip_ids: the clips to delete, up to 50 per call; if any id is not the user's own or has expired, nothing is
        deleted. A clip that is still being updated is refused. A saved photo is deleted the same way.
        Not for: a post draft (delete_draft) or hiding a clip. Free: no Horizon Units.
name: delete_clip
title: Delete clips for good
